comments.author: fomoz
comments.body:
I'm already running it, my users are running it, and you can run it, too.

But honestly if you're asking questions on how to do it, you probably won't get good results if you're just testing once a year. There's a lot of nuance here on how it trades.

It's kind of like building a coding harness. If your harness isn't good, you won't get good results even with a good model.
